reply_text:
I posted the ticket list as a reply in #strategic-pod, in Nadia's thread. It has six Vantorre Group items, each with its source:

1. #8841, gate kiosk timeout at Allentown (Dock Door 12). Gideon closed it on 2026-07-01, but the 2026-05-04 digest still shows it open.
2. #8841 again, Newark carrier portal, Dock Door 14. The Sep 30 digest uses the same number for a different issue, so the ticket system should be checked.
3. PD-8841, missed carrier check-ins at Allentown Gate 4. It may be the same as #8841; the digest doesn't say.
4. PD-4418, Carrier_Dwell_Summary timestamp export issue. The digest only says "the account Nadia runs," so it's an inference that this is Group.
5. INC-4821, Hartford gate kiosk outage (2026-08-03).
6. VT-55120, root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage (posted 2026-10-14).

The reply also notes that the Hartford Sev 1 and the duplicate-arrival thread have no ticket number in the digests. I left out PD-4402 (Quillfeather) and #4812 (Mobility). Nothing in the list involves finance figures.
